name: napa/search
description: Search NAPA auto parts by keyword with part number, brand, price, rating and store availability.

q.description: Parameter defines the search query. You can use anything that you would use in a regular NAPA Auto Parts search: a part name, a brand, or a part number, including the part numbers of other brands that NAPA products replace (e.g., `brake cleaner`, `Brakleen`, `CRC 05050`, or `PH3614`). Like on napaonline.com, some queries lead to a category of products (e.g., `oil filter` leads to Oil Filters). The category is returned in `search_information.category`. Others lead to another search (e.g., `generator` leads to `portable generator`), returned in `search_information.showing_results_for`.

page.description: Value is used to get results on a specific page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.). NAPA returns up to 12 results per page.

sort.description: Parameter defines the sorting of the results. It defaults to `relevance`. Available options: `relevance` - Relevance `price_low_to_high` - Price - low to high `price_high_to_low` - Price - high to low `product_description` - Product description `line_abbreviation` - Product line abbreviation `part_number` - Part number

store_id.description: Parameter defines the NAPA Auto Parts store to get the prices, promotions, and availability from. It's the number at the end of the URL of the store page on napaonline.com (e.g., `22706` for `https://www.napaonline.com/en/ca/healdsburg/store/22706`). It defaults to `28693`, a store in Chicago, IL. Prices and availability differ between stores, and only the products available to the store are listed.

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

# NAPA Auto Parts Search

Search NAPA auto parts by keyword with part number, brand, price, rating and store availability.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/napa/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"q": "brake pads"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.

| `sort` | string | No | Parameter defines the sorting of the results. It defaults to `relevance`. Available options: `relevance` - Relevance `price_low_to_high` - Price - low to high `price_high_to_low` - Price - high to low `product_description` - Product descrip |
| `page` | string | No | Value is used to get results on a specific page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.). NAPA returns up to 12 results per page. |

## Pricing

$0.010 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged.
